_about: Design parameters from Szonja's sheet, contracts/sources/chip_geometry_requirements.xlsx (Sizing Calculator, Geometry Requirements, Step 1 and Step 3 tabs). 'source' lists keys from 'sources' below. 'assumption': true marks rules of thumb the sheet says are not from a paper (confirm with Ayrton). Where the sheet gives a range, 'min'/'max' hold it and 'value' is null unless the sheet names a typical value. operator/sizing.py uses the same defaults; tests/test_sizing.py checks they agree.

10x.reference: 10x Genomics CG00054 Rev B (cultured cell lines)

inDrops.reference: Harvard Single Cell Core inDrops sample prep guide

TIP-seq.reference: Bartlett et al., J Cell Biol 220, e202103078 (2021)

Assumption.reference: Design rule of thumb, not from a paper: confirm with Ayrton

Textbook.reference: Standard physics / fluid mechanics values (e.g. water viscosity at 20 C, Sampson orifice flow, rectangular-channel resistance)

capsule.diameter_um.note: CapSeq typical 70 +/- 3 um; SPC methods paper 75 +/- 1.5 um; tunable 35-260 um

capsule.diameter_tunable_um.note: Range capsules can be made in

capsule.count.note: Sheet default. CapSeq says >100,000 CELLS per run; capsules needed = cells / mean cells per capsule (sizing.py cell mode)

capsule.swell_factor.note: Capsules swell >2x during culture without bursting; occupied capsules swell, empty ones don't

capsule.mean_cells_target.note: ~0.1 cells per capsule; most capsules empty. Size chambers by capsule count, not cell count

capsule.retained_nucleic_acid_min_bp.note: Capsule permeability: >300 bp kept. No geometry impact

capsule.enzyme_pass_max_kda.note: Enzymes under ~160 kDa pass the shell. No geometry impact

capsule_channel.width_factor_low.note: Rule of thumb to avoid clogging

capsule_channel.width_factor_high.note: Rule of thumb to avoid clogging

trap.gap_factor_high.note: Rule of thumb; check_chip_spec.py errors at or above this

culture.chamber_height_min_um.note: Culture chamber height and trap clearance >= ~150 um (swollen capsules)

culture.temp_c.note: Days-weeks in medium at 37 C, 5% CO2

release.outlet_min_width_um.note: Outlet sized for released spheroids (~150 um+) after collagenase release

size_sort.cutoff_um.note: Optional weir or DLD to drop empty (unswollen) capsules

cell_filter.gap_um.note: 10x 30 um; inDrops 40 um then 20 um; TIP-seq 30 um. Must be <= encapsulation nozzle width

cell_wash.dld_critical_diameter_um.note: Medium-exchange module replacing pelleting: DLD critical diameter ~8 um (or spiral inertial channel)

cell_wash.pellet_g.note: Bench step to be replaced: 250-300 g, 5 min, 4 C

dissociation.outlet_min_width_um.note: Outlet wide enough for detached cells and small clumps

wash.bench_g.note: Bench capsule wash, 2 min, 4 C; replaced on chip by a trap with back-flush

wash.exchange_steps_per_run.note: After lysis, RT, BC2, BC3, hairpin, final

lysis.gitc_molar.note: Harsh lysis with 4 M guanidinium thiocyanate for fragile cells; needs chemically resistant materials and a dedicated waste line

reagents.common_lines.note: Lysis, wash, hairpin ligation, protease, PCR mix, etc.

barcoding.chambers_per_round.note: MVP suggestion; CapSeq uses 96 wells per round

rt.temp_c.note: Typical RT temperature; exact value in CapSeq supplementary methods (not yet pulled)

pcr.max_temp_c.note: Index PCR; heater/Peltier capable of ~98 C under sublibrary chambers

ivt.time_h.note: Needs a sealed chamber against evaporation

mesh.open_fraction.note: TODO: open area of the bought mesh (woven nylon is typically 30-40%); from its datasheet

mesh.bed_resistance_kpa_per_ul_min.note: TODO placeholder: flow resistance of a full capsule monolayer on the mesh. The clean mesh is negligible (operator/flow_calc.py); the capsule bed dominates. The pressure sensor refits this

capsule.escape_pressure_kpa.note: TODO placeholder: pressure across the mesh at which soft capsules start squeezing through the opening; measure on the bench

capsule.loss_rate.units: fraction per 10 s per unit overpressure
capsule.loss_rate.note: TODO placeholder: how fast capsules escape above the escape pressure (model and virtual chip)

capsule.diffusion_time_s.note: CapSeq: reagents diffuse into capsules within minutes. 60 s first-order lag is a TODO placeholder

backflush.lift_flow_ul_min.note: TODO placeholder: upward flow that lifts a capsule monolayer off the mesh

thermal.tau_s.note: TODO placeholder: first-order time constant of a Peltier stage under the chip

dye.diffusivity_m2_s.note: TODO placeholder for a small-molecule dye in water; confirm from literature. Used by flow_calc's open-channel estimate (APPROXIMATE)

reservoir.default_ul.note: Starting volume of each reagent reservoir unless a scenario says otherwise

exchange.target_fraction.note: Default goal for an exchange step

exchange.interior_target_fraction.note: Goal inside the capsules (diffusion lag): the optimizer adds a no-flow soak until the capsule interior reaches this

control.pressure_margin.note: Plans must keep predicted pressure below this fraction of the escape pressure

control.error_threshold.note: Prediction error above this triggers a model update and re-plan

control.slices_per_wash.note: Executor time slices per wash (measure and correct after each)
